description.value:
Your familiarity with blasters has deepened. Once on each of your turns, drawing or stowing a blaster no longer uses your object interaction, and you no longer need a free hand to reload.

At 11th level, once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, it also takes an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon's damage; if you also apply Force-Empowered Shots to that same attack, add this damage to that feature's extra damage.
